summary: Interparfums Inc filed an 8-K on May 5, 2026, reporting first quarter 2026 results, reaffirming 2026 guidance, declaring dividends, and providing business updates including ESG rating increase and product innovation pipeline. The filing is a routine earnings release and operational update, not a special situation event. No M&A, activist, restructuring, or other special-situation activities are described. The registrant is the issuer of the press release. The filing includes standard items 2.02, 7.01, 8.01, and 9.01 for financial results and forward-looking information.
